verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch will be streamed live on NASA+.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Viewers can watch the event on NASA+, the space agency's free streaming service'; R2: 'Full launch coverage begins at 1 p.m. EDT on NASA+'; R4: 'Live and original programming is available on the agency’s free streaming platform, NASA+'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm live streaming on NASA+.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch will be streamed live on the NASA YouTube channel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on its ... YouTube channel. Live coverage ... on Youtube'; R2: 'NASA’s YouTube channel'; R4: 'YouTube'; R5: 'NASA broadcast both on YouTube and NASA+'
verifications.reasoning: Direct mentions of live streaming on NASA YouTube across sources.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II launch will be streamed live on the NASA app.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Programming is also available on the NASA App'; 'NASA App ... unlocks access to the agency's NASA+ streaming service'
verifications.reasoning: NASA App explicitly provides access to live programming including NASA+ streams.

verifications.claim: Live streaming of the Artemis II launch on NASA+, the NASA YouTube channel, and the NASA app starts around 7:45 a.m. ET.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Live coverage ... at 7:45 a.m. ET ... on Youtube'; 'NASA+ ... starting at 12:50 p.m. ET'; R2: 'at 7:45 a.m. on NASA’s YouTube channel'; 'Full launch coverage begins at 1 p.m. ... on NASA+'; R5: 'YouTube coverage begins ... at 7:45 a.m. EDT'; 'NASA+ ... beginning at 12:50 p.m. EDT'
verifications.reasoning: YouTube starts ~7:45 a.m., but NASA+ starts later (~12:50-1 p.m.); claim incorrectly attributes same start time to all.

verifications.claim: Coverage of the Artemis II launch on NASA+, the NASA YouTube channel, and the NASA app extends through the 10-day mission.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Coverage on NASA+ will soon conclude, however 24/7 coverage will continue on NASA’s YouTube channel ... throughout the mission'; R5: 'YouTube ... runs continuously through the entire 10-day mission'
verifications.reasoning: YouTube extends through mission, but NASA+ concludes post-launch; contradicts claim for all platforms.
